description: This file defines a Cache class providing static methods for managing a file-based cache system, including storing, retrieving, deleting cache items, and handling cache directory management.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: A utility class for handling file-based caching operations, including setting, getting, deleting cache entries and managing cache directories.

methods.name: getDirectory
methods.description: Returns the directory path used for caching, initializing it and printing a message if not already printed.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a cache item with a specified key and value.

methods.name: ensureCacheDirectoryExists
methods.description: Creates the cache directory if it does not already exist.

methods.name: forget
methods.description: Deletes the cache item associated with the given key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the cached value for a given key, if it exists.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Generates the full filesystem path for a cache key based on a hashed directory structure.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all cache files by recursively deleting the cache directory.

methods.name: rrmdir
methods.description: Recursively deletes a directory and its contents.
